description.desc_thousand_char: Roquette India Private Limited (RIPL), as per its credit rating report, is engaged in the business of manufacturing starch and starch derivatives. It has plants in Viramgam (Gujarat), Gokak (Karnataka), and Pantnagar (Uttarakhand), with a total maize-processing capacity of 2,720 TPD. The company's products include corn starch powder, liquid, and powdered glucose, modified starches, glucose D, dextrose monohydrate, maltodextrin, high-maltose corn syrup, and dextrose syrup, which are used in food processing, pharmaceutical, paper, textile, adhesive, ink, and paint industries. RIPL was incorporated in 2010 and has its registered office located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
